sections.description: CSS workspace for the Bricks builder.
sections.changelog:
1.9.0

Right-click numeric CSS lengths to choose unit conversions or labelled unit swaps. Expand tr + Tab in nested media and container query thresholds, with the correct media-query font basis. Conversion remains available when scrubbing is disabled, and numeric values then show the text cursor. Includes keyboard access, cancellation, and stale-token protection.
